description: 鹿児島県土砂災害警戒区域データ等 [landslides and debris flows and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 鹿児島県. 土砂災害防止法に基づき指定した土砂災害警戒区域データ. Coverage: 鹿児島県. The portal files it under the publisher 鹿児島県. Its tags are 土砂災害, 基礎調査, 特別警戒区域, 警戒区域. It offers 20 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-02-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
